ruleChangers.idol-of-eramir: in a sceptre, allies in your Presence share your Charges
ruleChangers.idol-of-oak: in a sceptre, Endurance Charges you would gain go to allies in your Presence instead
ruleChangers.idol-of-alira: in a sceptre, Power Charges you would gain go to allies in your Presence instead
ruleChangers.idol-of-kraityn: in a sceptre, Frenzy Charges you would gain go to allies in your Presence instead
ruleChangers.emergent-instinct: in a helmet, Blinded, Maimed and Bleeding targets can't Evade your hits
ruleChangers.carved-cunning: in a helmet, enemies on full Life can't Evade your hits
ruleChangers.carved-tenacity: in a helmet, enemies you Blind have no Critical Damage Bonus for 4 seconds
ruleChangers.warding-rune-of-nourishment: in armour, Life recovery from flasks also applies to Runic Ward
ruleChangers.warding-rune-of-annihilation: in a martial weapon, attacks spend Runic Ward to gain that much added Physical damage
ruleChangers.warding-rune-of-obsession: in a wand, all damage taken bypasses Runic Ward and its regeneration doubles
ruleChangers.warding-rune-of-equinox: in a caster weapon, Mana regeneration also recovers Runic Ward
ruleChangers.passion-of-aldur: in a weapon, its Cold and Lightning modifiers become equivalent Fire ones
ruleChangers.breath-of-aldur: in a weapon, its Fire and Lightning modifiers become equivalent Cold ones
ruleChangers.ire-of-aldur: in a weapon, its Fire and Cold modifiers become equivalent Lightning ones
ruleChangers.betrayal-of-aldur: in a weapon, its Fire, Cold and Lightning modifiers become equivalent Chaos ones
ruleChangers.rune-of-culmination: in a one-hand mace or quarterstaff, Physical damage rolls only its minimum or maximum
ruleChangers.rune-of-consistency: in a helmet, your hits lose their Critical Damage Bonus for 200% increased Critical Hit Chance
ruleChangers.serles-triumph: any equipment may have one more suffix modifier
ruleChangers.cadigans-epiphany: in gloves, their augment sockets are destroyed to make a Jewel socket
ruleChangers.astrids-creativity: any equipment may have one more crafted modifier
ruleChangers.voranas-carnage: a helmet can roll Berserking modifiers
ruleChangers.thruds-might: a weapon can roll Destruction modifiers
ruleChangers.medveds-tending: a body armour can roll Soul modifiers
ruleChangers.legacy-of-starkonjas-head: in a helmet, part of the damage from hits is taken from your Companion's Life first
ruleChangers.legacy-of-crown-of-thorns: in a helmet, grants the Pain Attunement keystone
ruleChangers.legacy-of-ezomyte-peak: in a helmet, grants Unwavering Stance
ruleChangers.legacy-of-deidbell: in a helmet, Warcries explode corpses for 10% of their Life as Physical damage
ruleChangers.legacy-of-the-smiling-knight: in a helmet, critical hits with attacks Aggravate Bleeding
ruleChangers.legacy-of-northpaw: in gloves, weapon attacks' base Critical Hit Chance becomes 7%, whatever the weapon
ruleChangers.legacy-of-bushwhack: in boots, your Physical damage Pins
ruleChangers.legacy-of-wanderlust: in boots, Slows no longer reduce your speed
ruleChangers.legacy-of-the-knight-errant: in boots, grants the Iron Reflexes keystone
ruleChangers.legacy-of-chernobogs-pillar: in a shield, Block chance becomes extra Fire damage
ruleChangers.legacy-of-svalinn: in a shield, Block is Lucky but blocked hits still deal 20% of their damage
ruleChangers.legacy-of-trenchtimbre: in a one-hand mace, your modifiers to minion attack speed also apply to you
ruleChangers.legacy-of-serles-grit: in a one-hand mace, its maximum Quality becomes 40%
ruleChangers.legacy-of-twisted-empyrean: in a two-hand mace, maximum Mana adds Cold damage to its attacks
ruleChangers.legacy-of-brain-rattler: in a two-hand mace, all its damage builds Electrocution, not only Lightning
ruleChangers.legacy-of-tyrannys-grip: in a spear, Strikes deal Splash damage
ruleChangers.legacy-of-ironbound: in a bow, Block chance adds Physical damage to its hits
